downloader.downloadOrder.title: Choose download order
downloader.downloadOrder.description: Other downloads from the same source are already running. Choose when to download the selected tasks.
downloader.downloadOrder.queueHint: Continue the current downloads while the selected tasks wait in the queue.
downloader.downloadOrder.priorityHint: Return running tasks from the same source to the queue and download the selected tasks first.
downloader.downloadOrder.closeHint: Closing this window also adds the selected tasks to the queue.
downloader.action.locateActive.tip: Scroll to the task the queue is currently working on.
downloader.toast.noActiveTask: No task is running right now.
downloader.toast.activeTaskFilteredOut: The active task is hidden by the current filters.
downloader.toast.noCompletedTasks: There are no completed tasks to clean up.
downloader.toast.noFailedTasks: There are no failed tasks to clean up.
downloader.confirm.deleteTask: Are you sure to delete it?
downloader.tip.allowDuplicateDesc: In general, it's not necessary to create identical tasks.
downloader.tip.autoRetryDesc: Retry automatically when the downloading task failed.
downloader.tip.checkpointManual: You can set the previous downloading checkpoint manually to make the downloader start the downloading task from it.
downloader.tip.checkpointAuto: In most cases, you should let this field set by downloader automatically.
downloader.tip.checkpointFormat: Each downloader has its own checkpoint format, and invalid checkpoint data will be ignored. You can find samples on our online document.
downloader.tip.responseTraffic: Response content actually read during this run; excludes uploads and protocol overhead.
downloader.tip.checkIntervalDesc: The interval (in seconds) after download completion or failure before restarting the task. Generally used for downloading content that updates periodically.
downloader.batchEdit.title: Batch edit ({{count}} tasks)
downloader.batchEdit.multipleValuesPlace: Multiple values — saving will overwrite this field for every selected task. Edit carefully.
downloader.batchEdit.overwriteWarning: Any field you touch will overwrite that field for all selected tasks when you save — even if you clear it or change it back.
Default path where downloads will be sav: Default path where downloads will be saved
Request interval help: Wait time between each request to avoid too frequent requests
Define how downloaded files should be na: Define how downloaded files should be named
Set a page range if you don't want to do: Set a page range if you don't want to download them all.
downloader.tip.preferTorrentDesc: If available, download torrent files instead of downloading images directly.
downloader.label.prioritizeTasksWithTorr: Prioritize tasks that have a torrent
downloader.tip.prioritizeTasksWithTorren: When enabled, single-work tasks are probed one by one, prioritizing those with a torrent. The selected acquisition method determines whether to download through BT or save the torrent file. Tasks without a usable torrent follow the direct-download fallback setting. Applies to Prefer BT download and Prefer saving torrent files.
downloader.tip.torrentCheckValidityHours: Once a gallery has been found to have no torrent, skip probing it again for this long. Re-running a large set of tasks otherwise re-checks every gallery from scratch. The result is stored on the task, so it survives a restart. Defaults to 24 hours; 0 always re-checks.
downloader.tip.exHentaiUserscript: You can use our Tampermonkey userscript to download from ExHentai with one click.
downloader.bilibili.noFavorites: Unable to retrieve Bilibili favorites. Please ensure your cookie is correctly set and that you have at least one favorite created.
downloader.config.autoStartAfterCreation: When enabled, new site downloads start automatically. General downloads join their download queue when created.
downloader.tip.torrentUnknown: This task has not been checked for a torrent yet.
downloader.tip.directDownload: Switch this task to direct download (consumes GP).
downloader.toast.directDownloadFailed: Could not start the direct download. Try again.
downloader.tip.torrentFoundAt: A torrent was found for this gallery on {{time}}.
downloader.tip.noTorrentCheckedAt: Checked on {{time}}: this gallery has no torrent, so its images are downloaded instead.
downloader.tip.torrentDisabled: "Prefer torrent download" is off for this task, so its images are downloaded directly.
downloader.results.title: Gallery download results
downloader.results.description: Each gallery shows content acquisition and optional follow-up processing separately. Open its BT transfer or workflow instance for details.
downloader.results.loadFailed: Could not load the results. Refresh to try again.
downloader.results.empty: No gallery results yet. Torrents and completed file downloads will appear here.
downloader.results.saveOnly: Result saved without a follow-up workflow.
downloader.results.filtered: Skipped because this result does not match the workflow’s result type filter.
downloader.results.acquisitionOwned: Started by acquisition task #{{id}}. Processing continues in its original workflow.
downloader.results.retryFailed: Could not start the retry. Refresh the status and try again.
downloader.page.title: Downloader
downloader.page.description: Manage downloads, follow progress, and inspect results.
downloader.empty.initialDescription: Create a task to follow its progress and find downloaded results here.
downloader.empty.filteredDescription: Try another search, source, or status, or reset the filters.
downloader.config.navigation.label: Downloader settings sections
downloader.config.general.description: Configure task behavior shared by all downloaders.
downloader.config.platform.description: Manage accounts, downloads, and requests for {{platform}}.
downloader.config.platforms.label: Download sources
downloader.config.platforms.loadFailed: Could not load download sources. Try again.
downloader.config.platforms.unavailable: No settings are available for this source yet.
downloader.tip.clickToCopyError: Click to copy the full error
downloader.error.noFolderAvailable: No downloaded file or output folder is available for this task.
downloader.error.openFolderFailed: Could not open the download folder
downloader.config.defaultDownloadPath.de: Sources without their own directory use a source subfolder here, for example Downloads/ExHentai. A source directory takes priority, and each task can override it. Applies to new tasks only.
downloader.config.sourceDefaultPath.inhe: Leave unset to use a source subfolder under the downloader default directory. If no default is set, choose a directory when creating a task.
downloader.config.sourceDefaultPath.over: This source uses the selected directory. A task can still choose another directory.
downloader.mode.label: Acquisition method
downloader.mode.directDescription: Download gallery contents directly from ExHentai using its download and GP settings.
downloader.mode.btDescription: Fetch torrent metadata internally and download its contents into this task’s output directory. Follow the transfer here or on the BT downloads page.
downloader.mode.torrentFileDescription: Save the .torrent file to this task’s directory. This alone does not download the contents.
downloader.mode.saveTorrentFile: Also keep the torrent file in the output directory
downloader.mode.fallbackToDirect: If no torrent is available, download directly (consumes GP)
downloader.mode.fallbackDescription: Only applies when no usable torrent is found. BT errors, missing peers and timeouts do not trigger direct download.
